reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthWideCategories / forEachMonthWideCategory / setMonthWideAvg helpers rather than adding new selection code.

duplication.why: The hidden-rule switch is written once in the shared query; copyPreviousMonth, which already had its own JS copy of the hidden check, gets a second form of the flag condition.

placement.why: The variation lives in the shared month-wide selection in budget/actions.ts, and a MonthWideArgs type expresses the shared argument shape.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' arguments, the selection helper and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: One explicit parameter on the shared helper with a default keeps behaviour unchanged; the remaining separate path in copyPreviousMonth means the rule still has two forms.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth keeps deciding the hidden rule on getBudgetData rows, now with its own `!includeHiddenCategories && (...)` condition, instead of going through getMonthWideCategories (pre-existing path, extended here).

disguised_duplication.where: The flag appears as a SQL filter in getMonthWideCategories and a JS guard in copyPreviousMonth, but that split predates the diff and is not reshaped to hide it.
